violations.description: No CI/CD is configured for this application, despite presence of both backend and frontend and test/lint scripts in frontend.
violations.evidence: No workflows exist in .github/workflows, and no alternative CI systems (.gitlab-ci, CircleCI, Travis, Jenkins) are present. No test/build/lint automation exists—only manual scripts in package.json and README.
violations.recommendation: Add CI to automatically lint (ruff/eslint), test, and build both backend and frontend on push/PR to reduce integration risks.

violations.description: No lint/format/tooling or configuration for the backend Python code: neither ruff, black, flake8, nor pyproject.toml config found.
violations.evidence: run_ruff found no lint config in backend or project root. Only frontend/eslint.config.js is present for JavaScript/TypeScript.
violations.recommendation: Add ruff or flake8 (and ideally black or similar) with CI enforcement for Python code to catch real defects and enforce standards.

violations.description: Insufficient version pinning for a deployable Python application: most requirements use only ">=" and there is no lockfile.
violations.evidence: requirements.txt entries are mostly '>=', e.g. fastapi>=0.104.0, uvicorn[standard]>=0.24.0, etc.; only some deps pinned. No lockfile or constraints file present. This is an app with Docker deployment, not a library.
violations.recommendation: Fully pin all production dependencies (==) or introduce a lockfile (e.g., piptools, uv-lock, poetry.lock) to ensure reproducible deploys.

violations.description: No tests (unit, integration, or frontend) exist for either backend or frontend.
violations.evidence: No Python or JS/TS test files/functions present. Searches for def test_, describe(, test(, and unittest/pytest/nose imports all returned no results in code or config.
violations.recommendation: Add test suites for backend (pytest or unittest) and frontend (Jest, Vitest, or similar) covering basic and critical flows.
